messages.subject: The classic inconsistent node error
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run a Bayesian Multistate Mortality model with 5 states. I have 52 individual fish tracked across 5 time steps. I am getting the error: 

Error in jags.model(file = "model.txt", data = jags.data, inits = jags.inits, : Error in node y[6,2] Node inconsistent with parents.

I've read discussions in this group where folks have had similar errors, with it often being issues with the priors or initial values. However, I have adjusted priors and initial values, but am still running into the same error. The error is consistently with the same node, which makes me think it may be a simple formatting error somewhere. My code and data are attached and any help is greatly appreciated!

Thanks,

-Tyler

messages.author: 312eda23f89ab6c6
messages.subject: AW: The classic inconsistent node error
parts:
Hi Tyler,

 

I could not solve the problem, but here are two observations about your model.

  • I think that the sum of the first row of your transition matrix does not sum to one, as it should.
  • The sum of the transition matrix of row 4 is 2, this is certainly wrong (but does not solve the problem)

If you can solve these issues, the model may work (perhaps).

 

Kind regards

 

Michael
